assumptions.statement: Official site and key-area polygons are absent; all submitted boundary-based areas use repository provisional rough geometry.
assumptions.impact: All land-use, green, public-space, building and phasing metrics must be recalculated after official polygons are issued.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, building density, setbacks and parcel controls are absent.
assumptions.impact: These indicators remain unknown; the proposal states qualitative design intent only.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines, transit integration conditions, parking survey and night-bus service data are absent.
assumptions.impact: Routes and crossings are concept diagrams, not engineering or traffic approval.

assumptions.statement: Building condition, ownership, tenancy, heritage grading and fire-safety surveys are absent.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish actions are decision rules, not building-by-building determinations.

assumptions.statement: Municipal capacity, utility corridors, emergency access and distributed energy conditions are absent.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure proposals require professional survey and authority confirmation.

assumptions.statement: No verified local workforce, shift-pattern, wage or service-demand baseline was provided.
assumptions.impact: Personas and the 12-station network are design hypotheses to be validated through paid worker participation and field research.

assumptions.statement: No personal tracking data is required or assumed.
assumptions.impact: Any future digital pilot must use data minimization, human escalation, public duty disclosure and independent audit.

assumptions.statement: The Zhongzhiyuan pilot has no confirmed parcel, building, asset owner, staffing roster, fire clearance, accessibility inspection, power source or implementation authorization.
assumptions.impact: The 90-day package is a reversible governance-and-space prototype only. It cannot install, open, claim service hours or connect to production systems before paid co-design and G1 professional checks.

assumptions.statement: No accountable site professional, evidence set or accepted threshold has yet been identified for the seven G1 verification domains.
assumptions.impact: The G1 sheet is a local working template only; an empty, incomplete or failed sheet requires no installation and no opening.

assumptions.statement: Participant availability, compensation basis, work-time status, personal-data handling and recording rules have not been agreed.
assumptions.impact: The workshop kit cannot recruit, record or claim paid co-design until these terms are written and accepted by participants and accountable organizers.

assumptions.statement: No approved data-retention, access-control, publication or independent-review protocol exists for the shift log.
assumptions.impact: The log is limited to the proposed de-identified service template; no personal or production data may be collected before a separate governance protocol is approved.

assumptions.statement: The three-area daily scripts use four conceptual time windows, personas, service moves and spatial actions; no verified roster, footfall baseline, site observation or operating authorization has been supplied.
assumptions.impact: The scripts communicate a testable people-service-space sequence only. They do not confirm a site, opening hour, workforce arrangement, route, facility condition or implementation commitment and must be validated before activation.

assumptions.statement: The 84-second accessible tour is a silent presentation sequence built from existing conceptual scenes and daily scripts; it has no verified site footage, roster, footfall, service-hours or accessibility inspection input.
assumptions.impact: Captions, transcripts, route overlays and pause conditions communicate the proposal's intended safeguards only. They do not verify real-world accessibility, staffing, service availability, safety or implementation authorisation.

assumptions.statement: The three-area operating and audit pack has no confirmed parcel, asset owner, roster, service-hour baseline, safety clearance, access inspection, data-governance protocol or implementation authorisation.
assumptions.impact: It remains a conceptual reversible working template. Any missing, failed or incomplete gate requires no installation and no opening; official geometry and specialist checks remain prerequisites for future use.
